crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned…
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace…
For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire…
I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and…
Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire…
His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
for our God is a consuming fire.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And the appearance of the glory of Jehovah was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
